verdict.rationale: Pulumi's core value proposition is defining infrastructure in general-purpose languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java) with full access to language features like loops, functions, classes, and types, backed by standard IDE tooling via SDKs; this is corroborated by community testimonials praising the type system and language ergonomics. Missing for 10: no direct evidence of specific IDE plugin/autocomplete features beyond inferred SDK typing benefits, and some community complaints about complexity/documentation temper a perfect score.
